requirements.name: A notification declares one commodity type, which decides the categories on offer

scenarios.name: Potatoes narrows a line to the two potato categories

tests.test: offers only the categories the chosen commodity type allows
tests.notes: asserts exactly seed-potatoes and ware-potatoes radios, count 2

tests.test: each commodity type offers only the categories that belong to it
tests.notes: potatoes branch: seed and ware visible, categoryRadios count 2

scenarios.name: Plants for planting narrows a line to the two planting categories

tests.test: each commodity type offers only the categories that belong to it
tests.notes: plants-for-planting branch: plants for planting and trees for planting visible, count 2

tests.test: hints the two plants categories that need explaining
tests.notes: asserts both plants category hints are shown; does not re-assert radio count 2

scenarios.name: Wood and cut trees narrows a line to the five wood categories

tests.test: offers the five wood categories with the preservative guidance
tests.notes: asserts count 5 and the wood-specific category hint

tests.test: each commodity type offers only the categories that belong to it
tests.notes: wood branch: cut coniferous trees visible, categoryRadios count 5

requirements.name: A notification must hold at least one commodity line

scenarios.name: A notification with no line at all is rejected at continue

tests.test: holds an emptied consignment at the collection floor
tests.notes: changes type to empty the list, then continue is refused naming commodityLines, focus on #commodityLines

tests.test: an emptied consignment is held at the at-least-one error
tests.notes: error summary contains Add at least one commodity

requirements.name: Every commodity line declares a category and a quantity

scenarios.name: A line cannot be saved without a category

tests.test: continuing with no category shows the error and focuses the first radio

scenarios.name: A line cannot be saved without a valid quantity

tests.test: refuses a quantity that is not a whole number above zero
keeps what was typed when a required field is left blank

requirements.name: A line's category decides which further fields it is asked for

scenarios.name: A potato line asks for variety and intended use, not genus or commodity code

tests.test: asks a potato line for its variety, quantity and intended use
tests.notes: also asserts genus and commodityCode fields have count 0

tests.test: a potato line is asked for its variety, quantity and intended use
tests.notes: saves a potato line and asserts list row; does not assert genus/commodity-code absence on the details page

scenarios.name: A trees-for-planting line asks for a size as well as genus, species and commodity code

tests.test: asks a trees-for-planting line for its size as well
tests.notes: asserts species, eppoCode and sizeOfTree all visible; genus/commodity-code implied by the category's field set

scenarios.name: A conifer-wood line asks for phytosanitary treatments, not a genus

tests.test: asks a conifer wood line for treatments and no genus
a wood line is asked for its treatments, and a cut-tree line for their size
tests.notes: cut coniferous trees: treatments and size visible, genus count 0

scenarios.name: A hardwood line's genus is narrowed to the three hardwood genera

tests.test: narrows the genus type-ahead to the hardwood genera
tests.notes: hardwood-chips: Castanea offered, Picea (full-list-only genus) absent

requirements.name: Changing the commodity type discards lines that no longer match

scenarios.name: Changing type warns before any line is removed

tests.test: warns before a change that would remove saved lines
changing the commodity type removes the lines the new type cannot hold
tests.notes: asserts linesWarning visible before saving the new type

tests.test: renders the caption, the legend as the page heading and the hint
tests.notes: asserts the warning is hidden when no lines exist yet — the positive show-when-lines-exist case is the list.fit test above

scenarios.name: Confirming a changed type reports what was removed

tests.test: reports what a change of type removed, and offers a fresh start
tests.notes: 1 potato line removed, wood type named, empty-state and Add another shown

tests.test: changing the commodity type removes the lines the new type cannot hold
tests.notes: removed banner names wood type; empty state; table count 0
